status: Inspected by Codex only; not applied or benchmarked
mechanism: A reduced draft output vocabulary is expanded into full target-vocabulary logits through the d2t row map. This is a model-specific local MTP output-head optimization, not remote weight partitioning.
qualification_gates: Validate d2t dimensions, integer type and index range against the target vocabulary.
Establish deterministic handling or rejection of duplicate d2t indices.
Compare target outputs and fallback behavior with MTP disabled under matched sampling.
Qualify hybrid-state checkpoint/rollback before any NodeLift native speculative path.
Measure accepted-token benefit against map/scatter and target verification costs on Metal; do not transfer CUDA numbers to the Mac or phones.
